title: Nutlope/hallmark
title_zh: Hallmark 反 AI 味设计技能

paragraphs.en: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
paragraphs.zh: 适用于 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 的反 AI 垃圾内容（Anti-AI-slop）设计技能。

paragraphs.en: A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated.
paragraphs.zh: 一个适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和 OpenCode 的设计技能，它拒绝让自己的作品看起来像 AI 生成的。

paragraphs.en: usehallmark.com · forty-eight themes · custom on request · redesign and audit by name
paragraphs.zh: usehallmark.com · 四十八个主题 · 可按需定制 · 由具名设计师提供重设计与审计

paragraphs.en: Hallmark holds a hard floor and then gets out of the way. It deals three themes from a catalog of forty-eight materials, builds the page around what the visitor came to do, and lints the result in a real browser against the tells that read as machine-made: the eyebrow above every heading, tracked-capital labels, one coloured word in a headline, a page of empty frames or nothing but photographs, a hero that misses its screen, an email sign-up at the end of every page, a form that says thanks without sending anything. A fresh-context reviewer gets the last word.
paragraphs.zh: Hallmark 设有一条硬性底线，然后就不再干预。 它从四十八种素材目录中挑选三个主题，围绕访客前来要做的事情来构建页面，并在真实浏览器中对结果进行 lint 检查，排查那些读起来像机器生成的破绽：每个标题上方的引导小标题、加宽字距的全大写标签、标题中唯一的彩色词、满页空框架或清一色的照片、错失屏幕的 hero 区、每页末尾的邮件订阅，以及什么都没发送却道谢的表单。 由具备全新上下文的审阅者做最后定夺。

paragraphs.en: The gates come in tiers. The Floor never ships (contrast, focus, reduced motion, invented facts, a broken phone layout). Reflex gates are the defaults a model falls into; a build with a reason may overrule one on the record. Finish checks are craft detail that never blocks a ship.
paragraphs.zh: 这些门槛分为不同层级。 底线绝不放行（对比、聚焦、减少动效、捏造的事实、损坏的手机端布局）。 反射性门槛是模型默认落入的规则；有理由的构建可以在记录在案的情况下推翻其中一条。 收尾检查是工艺细节，绝不会阻止发布。

sents.zh: 这些门槛分为不同层级。

paragraphs.en: Ten of the forty-eight. A theme is a material, not a plan: it never says what a page contains or in what order, so two prompts in one theme make two different pages. Each is one file of at most 8 KB in references/themes/ with a picture beside it; a build reads exactly one. See them all at usehallmark.com .
paragraphs.zh: 四十八个中的十个。 主题是一种素材，而不是一份计划：它从不说页面包含什么内容、以什么顺序排列，因此同一主题下的两个提示词会生成两个不同的页面。 每个主题是 references/themes/ 目录中至多 8 KB 的一个文件，旁边附有一张图片；一次构建只读取其中一个。 在 usehallmark.com 查看全部主题。

在 usehallmark.com 查看全部主题。

paragraphs.en: Say custom and Hallmark drops the themes: no plan, no components, no palette recipe, only the floor, the gates and a short direction in direction.md to find one idea that only this client has and let it run the page.
paragraphs.zh: 说 custom，然后 Hallmark 给出主题：没有计划、没有组件、没有配色配方，只有场地、关卡，以及 direction.md 中一段简短的方向指引，去找到只属于这个客户的那个想法，并让它主导整个页面。

paragraphs.en: Each page is self-contained HTML and CSS, stamped in its first CSS comment with the decisions it took.
paragraphs.zh: 每一页都是自包含的 HTML 和 CSS，并在其首个 CSS 注释中标记了它所做出的决策。

paragraphs.en: Hallmark never starts on a design that already exists unless you name it:
paragraphs.zh: Hallmark 从不在已存在的设计上开始工作，除非你为它命名：

paragraphs.en: /hallmark redesign ./src/app /hallmark audit ./index.html A full redesign keeps the content and the wiring and changes the system and the layout; say keep the layout for a restyle or polish for only the tells. sloplint --before records every link, field, handler and heading first, sloplint --kept fails the redesign if one went missing, and the handoff is a side-by-side before and after.
paragraphs.zh: /hallmark redesign ./src/app /hallmark audit ./index.html 完全重设计会保留内容和接线，但更改系统与布局；若要保留布局，请说 restyle（改样式），若只改细节特征，请说 polish（打磨）。sloplint --before 会先记录每一个链接、字段、处理程序和标题，sloplint --kept 会在重设计中丢失任何一项时判定失败，而交接产物是前后对照（side-by-side before and after）。

paragraphs.en: npx skills add nutlope/hallmark -g -g installs for every project; leave it off to install into the current one. Needs Node 18 or later. The browser checks ( sloplint --render , screenshots) also need npm i -g puppeteer-core and Chrome; without them the static checks still run.
paragraphs.zh: npx skills add nutlope/hallmark -g —加 -g 会在每个项目中安装；省略它则只安装到当前项目。需要 Node 18 或更高版本。 浏览器检查（sloplint --render、截图）还需要 npm i -g puppeteer-core 和 Chrome；如果没有它们，静态检查仍然会运行。

paragraphs.en: The photo library ( skills/hallmark/scripts/photos.json ) lists photographs hosted on Wikimedia Commons and holds no image files. Each keeps its own licence (CC0, public domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA), and Hallmark credits every one it uses on the page. It does not use stock sites (Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay), whose terms bar AI tools from picking their images.
paragraphs.zh: 照片库（ skills/hallmark/scripts/photos.json ）列出了托管在维基共享资源上的照片，本身不包含任何图片文件。 每张照片都保留其自身的许可协议（CC0、公有领域、CC BY 或 CC BY-SA），Hallmark 会在页面上注明其使用的每一张照片的来源。 它不使用图库网站（Unsplash、Pexels、Pixabay），这些网站的服务条款禁止 AI 工具选取其图片。
